hop_glosses: Hop 1 identifies the radiation via its wavelength band; hop 2 supplies what produces it.

sufficient_sets.text: An X-ray is a form of high-energy electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength shorter than those of ultraviolet rays and longer than those of gamma rays.
Whenever charged particles (electrons or ions) of sufficient energy hit a material, X-rays are produced.

labels.answer_text: charged particles (electrons or ions) of sufficient energy
